profile.headline: Video Applications Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m an engineer with over 8 years of experience building scalable iOS
applications and SDKs using modern Apple frameworks. Known for
mentoring, driving technical initiatives, and building developer-friendly
tools. Passionate about crafting clean architectures and enabling high-
performing teams through collaboration and technical leadership.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.locationName: Santa Monica, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Leading the development of premium Apple (iOS, tvOS, visionOS) applications in Red Bull’s global streaming ecosystem. I manage a cross-functional team of internal and third-party engineers to deliver high-quality, modular native apps built on a shared multi-tenant architecture. My focus spans technical leadership, agile delivery, architecture decisions, and operational excellence — from driving weekly deployments to ensuring 24/7 incident response readiness. I collaborate closely with product, design, and QA to push the boundaries of performance, configurability, and user experience across all Apple platforms.

projects.title: Red Bull AR
projects.description: A mobile game where users must scan a can of Red Bull to unlock a small set of games. The top scorers won a unique prize related to the sport or athlete in the game. I developed a SwiftUI app that launched a Unity app where the users engaged in gameplay. The app also offered the user a way to browse the leaderboards for the various games that were offered in the app. I also built a robust integration with Braze in order to deliver real-time notifications about their standing in the leaderboard.

projects.title: Red Bull Freestyle
projects.description: A unique social media experience that allows users to view and create recordings of freestyle rap. The application also enables users to audition for a chance to compete in a live freestyle rap tournament.
